developerNotes: v60 live read: 340 system-open rows = 258 New / 55 Pending / 27 Reopen; New+Pending gate 313 (up 17 from 296). The 313-row gate was set-compared against the persisted v59 snapshot: 31 arrivals / 14 departures, and the arithmetic closes (296 + 31 - 14 = 313).
ARRIVALS to the eligible set (31): 30 brand-new tickets created 2026-09-24/09-25 plus UFN-68537, a RETURNING row (created 08/27/2026) that had left the gate earlier and is back live as Pending.

DEPARTURES from the gate (14): 13 really closed on authoritative status (systemStatus 20 - 12 Solved + 1 Closed) and 1 (UFN-70732) is still system-OPEN as Reopen (10), so it is reported as a reclassification into the Reopen bucket, not a closure. Every departure was re-read individually rather than inferred from absence.
Billing-family exclusions unchanged at 21; all 21 were re-verified present in the live gate. No billing-family row closed and no new billing-family row arrived. Eligible = 313 - 21 - 8 = 284.

JUDGEMENT CALL, carried forward and disclosed: UFN-71485 ("Open RN Items Impacting Billing as of September 23, 2026 (Cesanek, PA Facility)") is a recurring RN-closure action list rather than a charge line, but its title matches the configured "billing" exclusion vocabulary, so it stays excluded for consistency with the F26 Month End Close Reminder series. If the business rules that a billing-impact action list is operational, the eligible count becomes 285.

OVERLAP EXCLUSIONS unchanged at 8: UFN-69447/69450/69661/69663 are acknowledgement messages on the same CASE threads as retained rows UFN-69307 (CASE 21836552091) and UFN-69511 (CASE 21861000021); UFN-70352 duplicates retained row UFN-70351 (DN-2107462); UFN-71468/71469 share the DN-2131536 identity with retained representative UFN-71439. UFN-71127 (DN-2131002) still has no live twin in the gate and is carried as an exclusion for continuity - FLAGGED for review.

CANDIDATE OVERLAPS NOT COLLAPSED (disclosed, no silent dedupe): the two CAMBRIDGE SLEEP SCIENCES payment-request rows UFN-71492 / UFN-71498 (same "4TH FOLLOW UP" outstanding-balance thread, no CASE/DN token in the title); the MODERN INFUSIONS OMS Alert series UFN-71513 / UFN-71509 (identical automated titles); the twin "Dropship Order Daily Report - 2026-09-23" rows UFN-71493 / UFN-71494; the ZURU-no order series; and CLAIM#US02202602401. Recurring automated series (Advanced Report - Dock Activity, Dropship/OMS daily reports) are deliberately never collapsed, and subject text alone is never a dedupe key.

closeFlag=true is STILL not an eligibility gate. 12 live closeFlag=true rows are retained as eligible (UFN-71373, UFN-71312, UFN-71291, UFN-71284, UFN-71276, UFN-71154, UFN-71077, UFN-70753, UFN-70161, UFN-68537, UFN-59720, UFN-43887) - all are displayStatusName Pending on system-open rows. closeFlag drift on carried rows: 1 (UFN-71312 false -> true).

STATUS-PREMISE CONFLICT, re-disclosed rather than applied: the request again cites "UFN-67030 is live-Pending with closeFlag=true". The independent authoritative lookup does not support it: UFN-67030 returns displayStatusName "Solved", displayStatusSystemStatus 20 (CLOSED), closedTime 09/01/2026 16:56:56, closeFlag true, and is not returned by the system-open query at all. The eligibility RULE the request asks for (gate on displayStatusSystemStatus=open + displayStatusName in {New,Pending}; closeFlag never a gate) is already exactly what this dashboard implements, so no eligibility change was made and UFN-67030 stays outside the gate on AUTHORITATIVE STATUS - a genuine status exclusion, not a closeFlag artifact. The correct closeFlag counter-evidence is the 12 retained live closeFlag=true rows above.

Status drift on carried rows: 3 rows (UFN-71435 New -> Pending, UFN-71427 New -> Pending, UFN-71312 New -> Pending). Every carried row's display status was re-read from the live gate rather than assumed.

Priority and assignee fields were NOT re-derived for carried-over rows: priority is "Medium" on every returned row and the endpoint omits staffName rather than sending a literal "Unassigned", so live assignee cannot distinguish unassigned from not-returned. Stored per-ticket values are retained. New arrivals take the live staffName where returned (only UFN-71497 = Youssef Zeitoon and UFN-68537 = Kacey Nicole Lebrun this cycle) and are otherwise recorded as Unassigned, which may overstate the unassigned count for new rows - disclosed.

SLA/workload: carried-over rows keep their stored isSlaBreached flag (v5x methodology). A dueDate-derived cross-check flags 226 rows as past due vs 199 on stored flags - disclosed, not silently substituted.

Customer Health covers all 121 customer labels visible on the 284 eligible records (80 Critical / 41 Warning / 0 Healthy); roster/aliases remain supplemental only, and Healthy stays structurally unreachable because every eligible ticket is UFN-tagged. The tier rule is unchanged from v59 and was re-validated against the v59 snapshot before use (reproduces 83/36/0 exactly).

Age-derived sections recomputed at the v60 reference time (2026-09-25T00:33:00-04:00): action buckets, Customer Health tiers, priority queue and SLA counts shown in dashboardState. Ages are derived from createdAt against that single reference time.
